title: The param dialog's `action?.title` fallback reads a key no author can write and no producer sets
body:
Found while implementing #4046 (deleting `ActionDef`'s index signature). Observation-class: dormant, nothing a user hits today. Filed rather than fixed — out of that card's scope.

## The read

`packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx:209`, titling the param-collection dialog:

```ts
title: action?.label || action?.title,
```

`title` is not declared anywhere an action can carry it:

- not in `@objectstack/spec`'s `ActionSchema` — `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` in `packages/core/src/actions/actionKeys.ts` is re-derived from the schema's own shape by `actionKeys.pin.test.ts`, and has no `title`;
- not on `@object-ui/types`' renderer view (`UIActionSchema`, `ui-action.ts`), which is where the sibling `description` *is* declared (`:521`);
- not on `@object-ui/types`' `crud.ts` `ActionSchema` or its `BaseSchema`;
- not forwarded by any of the four action renderers — `action:button`, `action:icon`, `action:group`, `action:menu` each forward `label` and `description`, none forwards `title`.

So the right-hand side of that `||` cannot be reached by authored metadata. It is live only for a host that hand-builds an action object in code and puts a `title` on it, which nothing in this repo does.

## Why it stayed invisible, and why it still is

The parameter is `action?: any` (`paramCollectionHandler`, `:167`), so the read type-checks regardless. That is also why #4046 did not surface it: closing `ActionDef` cannot reach a binding typed `any`. Worth recording explicitly — the natural assumption after #4046 is "unknown action keys are now compile errors", and this is a class that is not.

## Disposition

Two readings, and the choice is a judgement call rather than a defect:

- **Dead limb** — delete `|| action?.title`, leaving `title: action?.label`. Matches the `description` line directly below it, which reads exactly one key.
- **Undeclared host extension** — if a host passing `title` explicitly is a shape worth supporting, it should be declared on `ActionDef` like `description` now is, and the handler's `any` narrowed to `ActionDef` so the compiler covers this file at all.

Slight preference for the first: no producer sets it, and a fallback that cannot fire is the "declared ≠ enforced" shape #4046 exists to reduce. But it is one token either way, and narrowing that `any` is the larger and more valuable half of option two.

## Anchors

Verified on `origin/main` @ `4cb0562b5`.

- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx:167` — `action?: any`
- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx:209-210` — the `title` / `description` pair
- `packages/types/src/ui-action.ts:521` — `description?: string`, the declared sibling

Refs #4046, #4192.
